scope: Desktop native synthetic graph, mobile C ABI and Android build/packaging; not real-model or mobile-device qualification

jobs.name: laya (ubuntu-latest)
steps: Locate the explicitly installed native runtime
Run cargo test --no-default-features --features laya-dynamic,tokio --test laya_native native_worker -- --ignored
Run cargo clippy -p gen2-laya-mobile --features dynamic -- -D warnings
Exercise the mobile ABI against the native synthetic graph
Run python -m unittest discover -s tools/laya -p test_quality.py -v
